claim: An order word with no defined scope ('hold') causes fleet-wide thrash when misread once.

metric.what: Messages sent by the master in the 5 minutes after the order, in the 19 minutes after the person's correction, and received in the following hour.

countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: A hold is a record with scope, who it binds, what continues and what ends it. An unscoped hold from the person means 'stop bringing this to me'; the master confirms scope in one line before telling any lane.
whyItGeneralises: An order word with undefined scope is ambiguous for any fleet that relays orders through a coordinator; the cost grows with the number of lanes told.
